Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2409.11079

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of September 2024).
source_name: Afrouz Jabal Ameli, Faezeh Motiei and Morteza Saghafian, “On the MST-ratio: Theoretical Bounds and Complexity of Finding the Maximum”, arXiv:2409.11079 (2025).
statement:
For a point set in Euclidean space, the $k$-MAX-EMST-ratio problem restricts the input to $k$ dimensions. **Fixed-dimensional hardness conjecture.** The $k$-MAX-EMST-ratio problem for $k\in\{2,3\}$ is NP-hard.

The unrestricted MAX-EMST-ratio problem is established to be NP-hard, while hardness in the specific practical dimensions $2$ and $3$ remains conjectural.
title: Fixed-dimensional hardness conjecture for MAX-EMST-ratio
